input.query: How do signed model artifacts help detect corruption during installation?
documents: The loader hashes downloaded artifact bytes and checks their digest against the signed manifest before execution.
The application chooses a new color theme when installation finishes.
The loader ignores an incorrect checksum and executes the incomplete model.
